user.title: Add Adaptive Room Manager
user.description: Choose whether to configure home-wide defaults or add a room based on an existing Home Assistant area.

home.title: Home Settings
home.description: Configure the global day, evening, and night schedule. Illuminance threshold and absence delay are used as defaults when new rooms are added.

room.title: Add an adaptive room
room.description: Select an existing Home Assistant area and configure its presence and lighting behavior. A dedicated device will be created for the room.

data_description.temporary_presence: Motion, door, occupancy, or any other entities that briefly indicate presence.
data_description.persistent_presence: TVs, media players, sleep modes, bed occupancy, or any entities that keep the room occupied while active.
data_description.lux_sensors: Natural illuminance is stored while managed lights are off. Lights are never switched off temporarily to perform a lux test.
data_description.covers: Unavailable covers are ignored. An available cover not reporting closed is treated as open.
data_description.day_lights: Lights used during the day profile.
data_description.evening_lights: Lights used during the evening profile.
data_description.night_lights: Lights used during the night profile.

abort.already_configured: This Home Settings entry or Home Assistant area is already managed.

init.title: Adaptive Room Manager settings
init.description: Change the settings for this entry. Home Settings contain the global schedule; room settings contain only room-specific sensors, lights, threshold, and delay.
